description: This file defines the `HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Switch` class, which acts as a decorator to switch between two attribute definitions based on a token's value in the context of HTML attribute validation.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Switch
classes.description: A decorator class that switches between two attribute definitions depending on a token in the context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the switch with a tag name and two attribute definitions.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the string based on the current token in the context, delegating to the appropriate attribute definition.
